firm_data.firm_description: Amato Law Group, PLLC offers full-service support to clients facing a variety of property-based legal issues. The firm's real estate department ranks among the five largest real estate firms on Long Island.
notable_facts: Founded in 1995 by Alfred L. Amato
Offices in Garden City, Manhattan and Metuchen, NJ
Represents Fortune 100 companies, national banks, real estate developers, small businesses, private lenders, start-up entities and individuals.

email.subject: AI for Amato Law Group, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Alfred,

With your real estate department ranking among the five largest on Long Island, you're competing on deals that demand precision and speed. We see this constantly: growing firms balancing BigLaw-caliber work with leaner operations.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms exactly like yours. We recently raised $5M, and practices across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters to regional firms: client trust, accuracy, and real efficiency gains.

We've completed successful pilots on the East Coast and are now meeting firms across the region. I'd love to stop by your Garden City office and show you how we're helping similar practices stay competitive without the overhead.

Worth 20 minutes this week?

Vasu
Lucio
